requirements.quote:
QUIC requires that the cryptographic handshake provide authenticated
   protocol negotiation.
requirements.condition: When negotiating the application protocol for a QUIC connection
requirements.required_behavior: Bind the protocol negotiation to the authenticated cryptographic handshake.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Accept an unauthenticated application-protocol selection as the negotiated result.
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiation tampering can be injected and the accepted protocol compared with the value authenticated by the handshake transcript.

requirements.quote:
Unless another
   mechanism is used for agreeing on an application protocol, endpoints
   MUST use ALPN for this purpose.
requirements.condition: When no alternative mechanism is used to agree on an application protocol
requirements.required_behavior: Use TLS ALPN to negotiate and select the application protocol.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Complete application-protocol agreement without ALPN or another agreement mechanism.
requirements.why_checkable: The TLS handshake messages and endpoint configuration can be inspected for ALPN when no alternate mechanism is configured.

requirements.quote:
When using ALPN, endpoints MUST immediately close a connection (see
   Section 10.2 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT]) with a no_application_protocol TLS
   alert (QUIC error code 0x0178; see Section 4.8) if an application
   protocol is not negotiated.
requirements.condition: When ALPN is used and no application protocol is negotiated
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Keep the connection open or defer closure after negotiation ends without an application protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can offer no mutually supported ALPN value and the endpoint's immediate transition to connection closure can be observed.

requirements.quote:
with a no_application_protocol TLS
   alert (QUIC error code 0x0178; see Section 4.8) if an application
   protocol is not negotiated.
requirements.condition: When closing because ALPN did not negotiate an application protocol
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a different error identity for the ALPN no-protocol failure.
requirements.error_behavior: Send or report no_application_protocol, mapped to QUIC error code 0x0178.
requirements.why_checkable: The closing alert and QUIC CONNECTION_CLOSE error field can be decoded and compared with no_application_protocol and 0x0178.

requirements.quote:
QUIC clients MUST use error 0x0178 to terminate a
   connection when ALPN negotiation fails.
requirements.condition: When ALPN negotiation fails at a QUIC client
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Continue the failed-ALPN connection or terminate it under another error code.
requirements.why_checkable: An ALPN failure can be induced at the client and the resulting connection termination code inspected.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST select an application protocol compatible
   with the QUIC version that the client has selected.
requirements.condition: When a server selects an application protocol for a client-selected QUIC version
requirements.required_behavior: Select an application protocol that is compatible with that QUIC version.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Select an application protocol that is incompatible with the client-selected QUIC version.
requirements.why_checkable: A test matrix of declared application-protocol and QUIC-version compatibility can compare the server's selection with the client-selected version.

requirements.quote:
The server MUST
   treat the inability to select a compatible application protocol as a
   connection error of type 0x0178 (no_application_protocol).
requirements.condition: When a server cannot select an application protocol compatible with the client-selected QUIC version
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the condition as a connection error.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Proceed with the connection using an incompatible or absent application protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: A client can offer only incompatible protocol/version combinations and the server's closing error code can be observed.

requirements.quote:
a client MUST treat the selection of an incompatible
   application protocol by a server as a connection error of type
   0x0178.
requirements.condition: When a server selects an application protocol incompatible with the negotiated QUIC version
requirements.required_behavior: The client treats the selection as a connection error.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Accept or continue using the incompatible application protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: A server can select a deliberately incompatible application protocol and the client's connection error response can be inspected.
